thread:
maddie: Quick sync — aiming to roll ElmBridge (private) to dedicated cluster eu-west-1 tonight 02:00 UTC. Canary plan: 3% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m. Need final thumbs and KMS window check. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jon: +1 on schedule from SRE side. What's the model/runtime pin?
sana: KMS rotation ends 01:45 UTC for that account — can we move to 02:30 if needed?
maddie: Good catch. We can shift to 02:30 but prefer 02:00 if ops ok. Pinning runtime to runtime-server v2.10.1 and model to elmbridge-enc-v1.4.2. Fallback is elmbridge-enc-v1.4.0-quantized.
rachel: Release notes here: https://redwood-internal/release/elmbridge/1.4.2 — includes perf fixes and a pullthrough change. I've flagged the extra telemetry hooks.
jon: Rollback triggers I want recorded: sustained 5xx rate > 0.7% for 5m OR 95th latency > 350ms for 2m. Also if error budget burn > 30% in 15m.
maddie: Agreed. Also adding a soft throttle: if token cost jumps >20% vs baseline for 10m, canary hold.
ops-bot: @maddie @jon @sana — preflight checklist: KMS key OK, secrets accessible, canary slice configured, priming job queued.
deploybot: Received deploy request. Preparing canary job.
maddie: I'm going to start the priming step 45m before cutover to populate KV cache and warm the prefix cache. Priming script:
```
# priming tenants
python tools/prime_kv.py --tenant elmbridge --to 3pct --duration 120
```
jon: Add a quick smoke that hits the conversation and embeddings endpoints (10 reqs each) after priming.
sana: Confirmed — KMS rotation complete at 01:20 UTC in the other region. For eu-west-1 it's 01:45 so we need the 02:30 start if we want a clean gap. Ops prefers 02:30.
maddie: Ok changing to 02:30 then. Can everyone ack: runtime pin + model pin + safety gates?
rachel: Ack from product/notes side, LGTM.
jon: Ack from SRE (watching metrics and ready to cut if canary OK).
sana: Ack from infra, KMS good for 02:30.
deploybot: /deploy --target elmbridge-prod --cluster dedicated-eu-west-1 --canary 3% --steps 3 --runtime v2.10.1 --model elmbridge-enc-v1.4.2
deploybot: Canary job started (job id: canary-5521122334-01). Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana/internal/d/elmbridge-canary
maddie: Leaving canary stage auto-progress enabled but will hold on the defined rollback triggers. If anything looks off, @jon to hit the manual rollback.
jon: I have the rollback playbook open. Manual rollback command is:
```
deploybot rollback --job canary-5521122334-01 --to model=elmbridge-enc-v1.4.0-quantized
```
ops-bot: Pager contacts: jon, maddie, rachel. On-call SRE will escalate to infra lead after 10m of unresolved high severity.
maddie: Final note: customers with dedicated capacity get zero-downtime migration, but we will announce a 30m quiet window to ElmBridge ops for safety. Posting release notes to tenant slack after cutover. :rocket:
